scope: Full finite-window graph for 640 samples at 24 kHz; every temporal convolution/LSTM/RVQ route is enumerated then aggregated into 24×24 endpoint bins.
layout: Neuron-relative envelopes; occupied bins use the mean position of their actual neuron indices. Constants are centered. Labels are abbreviated; full labels are in nodes metadata.
semantics: Convolution padding and temporal positions follow Hugging Face Transformers EncodecModel 4.31.0. LSTM is unrolled across the finite latent frames. Every convolution, shortcut, recurrent matrix, bias, and all 32 RVQ embedding candidate-score/lookup alternatives contribute. RVQ argmax is input-dependent; all candidate lookup alternatives are shown. Constant-zero padded weight applications are counted separately and excluded from edge totals. Weight magnitude uses effective weight-normalized kernels; brightness is normalized per graph edge. No measured activations.
